title: Info-communications Media Development Authority (Amendment) Act 2026 (Act 13 of 2026); section 18 amends the Telecommunications Act
kind: the text of the Act or notification, from the e-Gazette copy
header_as_printed: Info-communications Media Development / Authority (Amendment) Bill / REPUBLIC OF SINGAPORE / Bill No. 9/2026. / GOVERNMENT GAZETTE / Read the first time on 7 April 2026. / ACTS SUPPLEMENT / Published by Authority / NO. 14] FRIDAY, JUNE 5 [2026 / First published in the Government Gazette, www.egazette.gov.sg, on 5 June 2026 at 5 pm. / The following Act was passed by Parliament on 7 May 2026 and assented to / by the President on 25 May 2026:— / REPUBLIC OF SINGAPORE / No. 13 of 2026.
first_published_line_as_printed: First published in the Government Gazette, www.egazette.gov.sg, on 5 June 2026 at 5 pm.
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
obtained_how: One GET request (python urllib, scratchpad tools/gazette-fetch5.py), User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", five seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository, at the exact URL the team lead gave from the e-Gazette browse page. The assets host answered 200 with Content-Type application/pdf. No search path was used. The text is the output of "pdftotext -layout" on a PDF with a text layer (no OCR), unedited.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/, clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; the wording is quoted in the licence note.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents." This item was first published on 5 June 2026, AFTER that date; what the FAQ says of copies published from 9 March 2025 was not read for this note, so the evidentiary status of this copy is not stated here.
